Being immobile for long periods of time makes blood clots more likely to form.
When you are immobile for long periods of time, blood flow in your veins, especially in the legs, becomes poor, leading to the formation of blood clots.
Long-flight syndrome (also known as economy class syndrome) is caused by blood clots formed in this way.
There are several ways to prevent long-flight syndrome.
The first is to move around.
Don't be shy about going out into the aisle and doing some stretches, or even trying to move your legs while you're in your seat.
The second is to stay hydrated.
The air inside a plane is surprisingly dry, so you need to drink plenty of water.
Staying hydrated will encourage you to use the toilet more often, and it also serves as exercise.
The third is compression stockings. I recommend the compression stockings sold by Terumo.
These are excellent products, and are also effective against leg swelling in people who do a lot of standing work.
The fourth is aspirin.
While there is some doubt as to whether they are effective against venous thrombosis, they are a very effective preventative medication.
However, it is difficult to get the appropriate dosage, so you should always get a doctor's prescription.
The fifth is a nattokinase supplement.
If you want guaranteed results, choose a product of reliable quality.
For Nattofemin, we recommend taking two tablets every eight hours.

凝固系と線溶系に作用する薬を服用中は、納豆を食べてはいけません。\n納豆に含まれ:
Do not eat natto while taking medications that affect the coagulation and fibrinolytic systems.
The vitamin K contained in natto antagonizes anticoagulants such as warfarin, weakening its effectiveness.
Although natto bacteria are sold as a health food, they should also be avoided. There are reports that natto bacteria produce vitamin K in the intestines.
Natto and related products are contraindicated for people taking warfarin. There is information that nattokinase can be safely taken while taking warfarin. However, there are no published studies to support this claim.
Even if it were safe, the fibrinolytic system is already dominant while taking warfarin, so there is probably no need to take nattokinase (additive effect). It cannot be considered safe because it does not inhibit the effects of warfarin.
Natto should also generally be avoided while taking medications such as urokinase that affect the fibrinolytic system.
Medications are administered in amounts that are expected to have a therapeutic effect, so there is no need to take nattokinase (additive effect). Consult your doctor for more details.
There should be no problems with medications other than those that affect the coagulation or fibrinolysis systems.
There have been no reported problems with people taking aspirin after eating natto. However, if you are taking aspirin to inhibit platelet aggregation, you should consult your doctor.
Some parts of this section are written in a subdued tone, but it contains extremely important information. Please do not be misled by the advertising claims of health food companies or the words of pharmacists who simply echo them, and consult your doctor.
Q\n納豆には副作用はありませんか？:
Q
Does natto have any side effects?
自然食品や漢方薬には副作用がないと考える方がいます。しかし、それは正確ではありま:
Some people believe that natural foods and herbal medicines have no side effects. However, this is not accurate.

Some natural foods and herbal medicines do not contain any medicinal ingredients.

Some contain ingredients that are not biologically active. In these cases, they are ineffective and therefore have no side effects.


Leaving this aside, the reason people tend to think that natural foods and herbal medicines have no side effects is probably because they are associated with food. Rice, wheat, sugar, and milk are all foods that humans have consumed for many years. This is why they are considered safe.

However, this way of thinking is a bit dangerous. Food contains a variety of nutrients. Therefore, each substance is present in trace amounts.

Some substances are safe in trace amounts but dangerous in large amounts.

Drinking a little too much tea is not dangerous. However, this does not mean that all the ingredients in tea are safe.

Suppose you extract only the caffeine from tea. You can easily ingest the amount of caffeine in 10 liters of tea, but this is dangerous. Just because something is extracted from food does not mean it is free of side effects.

Amid the health food boom, extracting only certain substances from existing foods has become widespread. Some of these may be safe, but they may also contain dangerous substances.
Just because a food is natural does not necessarily mean it is safe.
Extracting only specific substances from food is more like a drug than a food. All drugs have side effects.
Noting that natto itself has no side effects, Nabio aims to create products that make use of the whole, natural properties of food (WHOLE FOOD).
